question: How does the deity bestow sovereignty and self to devotees and beings?
premises: The deity gives Bali his own kingdom
The deity is the imperishable giver of self to all gods and sages
inference: The deity grants both worldly sovereignty and the gift of self while remaining imperishable
uncertainties: The internal analysis of sarva+deva+vipra+ātma+da+acyutaḥ is interpretive
plain_english: He gives Bali his own kingdom and, as the imperishable one, gives himself to all gods and sages.
